Rashi on Arakhin 30b:11:1.hebrew: ונעשה משרת - שהיה נעשה משרת לעבודת כוכבים, לחטוב עצים ולשאוב מים:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:11:1.english: And becomes a servant - [Meaning] that he would become a servant to idol worship, to chop wood and to draw water:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:12:1.hebrew: א"ל - אביי לההוא מרבנן, אפ"ה הא אהדריה קרא שיהו מרחמין עליו:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:12:1.english: He said to him - Abaye [said] to that [one] of the Rabbis: Even so, behold, the verse restored him, [meaning] that they should have mercy on him:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:12:2.english: Should I throw a stone [after the fallen] - that is to say, that he should never be redeemed:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:12:3.hebrew: נחמיר - עליה, שאם נמכר במנה והשביח — יחשב במאתים, או אם נמכר במאתים והכסיף — יחשב במאתים, כדכתיב (שם) "מכסף מקנתו":
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:12:3.english: We will be stringent - upon him: that if he was sold for a maneh and appreciated [in value], he is reckoned at two hundred [zuz], or if he was sold for two hundred [zuz] and depreciated [in value], he is reckoned at two hundred [zuz], as it is written (there): "from the money of his purchase":

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:14:1.hebrew: וכי יש שנים מרובות - שתהא שנה יתירה מחבירתה, דקאמר קרא "אם עוד רבות בשנים", או שנה פחותה מחבירתה:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:14:1.english: Now, are there many years - [meaning] that one year is longer than another, as the verse states, "if there are still many years" [Leviticus 25:51], or one year is shorter than another:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:14:2.hebrew: אלא - הכי קאמר קרא: אם יש ריבוי בכספו בשנים שהוא עומד בהן, כלומר מה שהשביחו, ישיב גאולתו "מכסף מקנתו", דאין מחשב אלא כמה שנמכר; ואם מעט נשארו דמיו בשנים שהוא עומד בהן, כגון שהכסיף, "כפי שניו ישיב את גאולתו":
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:14:2.english: Rather - This is what the verse is saying: If there is an increase in his value during the years in which he is standing [now] — that is to say, that he appreciated [in value] — he shall return his redemption “from the money of his purchase,” for one only calculates [according to] how much he was sold for; and if little of his value remains in the years in which he is standing [now] — for example, that he depreciated [in value] — “according to his years he shall return his redemption”:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:15:1.hebrew: ואימא - הכי קאמר קרא: היכא דפלח ליה תרתי שני ופשו ארבעי עד יובל, ליתיב ליה כמה שמגיע לארבע שנים מכסף מקנתו, לפי חשבון שקנאו:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:15:1.english: But say - Thus the verse is saying: where he served him [for] two years and four [years] remain until the Jubilee, let him give him the amount corresponding to four years from "the money that he was bought for," according to the calculation [of what] he bought him [for]:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:15:2.hebrew: כפי שניו - לפי שנים שהיה עדיין חייב לעובדו, ולאו בהכסיף והשביח משתעי קרא:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:15:2.english: According to his years - According to the years that he was still obligated to serve him, and the verse is not speaking of [a case where he] depreciated or appreciated [in value]:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:19:1.hebrew: ומצא את רעהו ומת - שהיה חבירו מצוי שם בשעה שהרים זה הגרזן, חייב; פרט לממציא את עצמו, דפטור זה מגלות:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:19:1.english: And [the blade] finds his fellow and he dies - [meaning] that his fellow was [already] present there at the time this [person] raised the ax, [in which case] he is liable; [this] excludes one who introduces himself [into the danger], for [then] this [person] is exempt from exile:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:1:1.hebrew: הריני - משובח במקומי, שאני דרשן ובקי כבן עזאי שהיה משתבח בשוקי טבריא, כדתניא בבכורות בפ' תשיעי (דף נח.): בן עזאי אומר, כל חכמי ישראל לפני כקליפת השום:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:1:1.english: I am - [i.e., I am] praised in my place, for I am an expositor and expert like ben Azzai, who used to boast in the markets of Tiberias, as it is taught in Bekhorot in the ninth chapter (58a): "Ben Azzai says: All the Sages of Israel are before me like a garlic peel":

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:1:2.english: They can be expounded - [meaning] these verses regarding a Hebrew slave:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:20:1.hebrew: מה השיגה ידו דהשתא - דודאי מעיקרא, כשמכרה, לא היתה ידו משגת, כדכתיב (שם) "כי ימוך אחיך ומכר מאחוזתו":
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:20:1.english: What is meant by “he prospers” [referring to] now - For certainly originally, when he sold it, he did not have the means [lit., his hand did not reach], as it is written (ibid.): “If your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his ancestral property”:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:21:1.hebrew: ואם גאל יגאל המקדיש וגו' מלמד שלוה - מאחר וגואל, ואם ירצה יגאל לחצאין:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:21:1.english: “And if [he] will indeed redeem [it], the one who consecrates,” etc., [this] teaches that he may borrow - from another [person] and redeem [it], and if he wishes, he may redeem [it] in halves:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:22:1.english: His power was diminished - As we said above:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:3:1.hebrew: מדרבי יוסי בר' חנינא - דודאי לא בא לידי כך, אלא מפני שהיה רשע ועושה סחורה בפירות שביעית:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:3:1.english: Due to [the statement of] Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Chanina - For certainly he did not come to this [state] except because he was wicked and would engage in commerce with produce of the Sabbatical year:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:3:2.english: The dust of the Sabbatical [Year] - [This refers to] one who trades in produce of the Sabbatical [Year]. And that is why [he] calls it "dust," because this is not the primary commandment of the Sabbatical [Year] prohibition:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:4:1.hebrew: וסמיך ליה וכי תמכרו ממכר - ודרשי' סמוכין, והכי אמר רחמנא: אם לא תשמרו מצות יובל, סופכם למכור מטלטלין וכלי תשמיש:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:4:1.english: And juxtaposed to it [is]: "And if you sell something" - And we expound juxtapositions [of verses], and thus says the Merciful One: If you do not observe the commandment of the Jubilee [Year], you will ultimately sell [your] movable property and articles of use:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:5:1.english: He did not feel [remorse] - he was not shaken [enough] to repent from the transgression:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:6:1.english: Does not come to him - [This] implies that it does not enter his mind that he is committing any transgression:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:7:1.hebrew: נעשית לו כהיתר - דומה בעיניו כהיתר. הלכך ברישא, דלא עבר עדיין אלא פעם אחת, תני "הרגיש", דמשמע שהיה יודע ונותן אל לבו שהיה עובר, אבל לא נרתע מן העבירה ועשאה; ובפעם שניה תני "לא באת לידו", שאפילו על לבו אין עולה שתהא עבירה:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:7:1.english: It becomes to him as permitted - It seems in his eyes as [something] permitted. Therefore, in the first clause, where he has only transgressed once so far, [the Tanna] teaches "sensed," which implies that he knew and took to heart that he was transgressing, but he did not recoil from the transgression and committed it; whereas regarding the second time, [the Tanna] teaches "it did not come to his hand," [meaning] that it does not even enter his heart that it is a transgression:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:9:1.hebrew: ניחא ליה לאיניש דליזבין ברתיה ולא לוזיף בריביתא - דריבית כתיב בהאי ענינא, דכתיב (ויקרא כה) "אל תקח מאתו נשך ותרבית וגו'", והא ודאי מקמי הכי כבר זבנה לברתיה, דבהכי ניחא ליה:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:9:1.english: A person prefers to sell his daughter and not to borrow with interest - For [the prohibition of] interest is written in this context, as it is written (Leviticus 25): "Take no usury from him or interest, etc.," and this [person] has certainly already sold his daughter before this, for that is preferable to him:

Rashi on Arakhin 30b:9:2.hebrew: פדיון בתו מגרעא ואזלא - שסתם מכירת הבת אינה שתהא שפחה אלא עד שיגיעו ימי נערות, ואם בא לפדותה בתוך כך, מחשב הדמים שמכרה כמה מגיע לכל שנה שהיתה ראויה להיות ביד האדון, ולפי אותו חשבון המגיע לכל שנה, מנכה לו האדון לכל שנה ושנה ששמשתו, כדתניא בקדושין (דף יא.): "והפדה" — מלמד שמגרעת פדיונה ויוצאה:
Rashi on Arakhin 30b:9:2.english: The redemption [price] of his daughter continuously decreases - For an ordinary sale of a daughter is not for her to be a maidservant [permanently], but only until [her] days of maidenhood arrive; and if he comes to redeem her in the meantime, he calculates [from] the money for which he sold her how much is due for each year that she was fit to be in the master's possession, and according to that calculation of what is due for each year, the master deducts for him for each and every year that she served him, as it is taught [in a baraita] in Kiddushin (11a): "[Then he shall let] her be redeemed" — this teaches that she deducts [from] her redemption [price] and goes free:

Tosafot on Arakhin 30b:11:1.hebrew: או לעקר זה הנמכר לעבודת כוכבים עצמה - לפי שסופן של עבודות כוכבים ליעקר, דריש הכי:
Tosafot on Arakhin 30b:11:1.english: Or to the offshoot [le'eker], this is one who is sold to idol worship itself - Because the ultimate end of idol worship is to be uprooted [le'aker], [the Tanna] expounds [it] thus:

Tosafot on Arakhin 30b:15:1.hebrew: ואימא היכא דעבד תרתי ופיישי ד' כו' - פירש רש"י: ולא בהכסיף והשביח מישתעי מידי. ול"נ, דא"כ אין זה כי אם מפשטיה דקרא, ובלא ייתור שמעינן ליה, ומשמע דרב נחמן בר יצחק מיתורא קא מפיק. לכן נראה לפרש: ואימא היכא דעבד תרתי ופייש ארבע, ניתיב ליה ארבע מכסף מקנתו, בין הכסיף בין השביח; והיכא דעבד ארבע ופייש ליה תרתי, ניתיב ליה תרתי כפי שניו, בין הכסיף בין השביח. ולהכי אתא יתורא דקרא, דלעולם אחר הסמוך אזלינן:
Tosafot on Arakhin 30b:15:1.english: But say [that] where he served two [years] and four remain, etc. - Rashi explained: [The verse] is not speaking at all of [whether he] depreciated or appreciated [in value]. But this does not seem [correct], for if so, this [interpretation] is nothing more than the plain meaning of the verse, and we would derive it without any superfluous word, whereas it is implied that Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak derives [his teaching] from a superfluous word. Therefore, it seems [preferable] to explain [the Gemara's question as follows]: "But say [that] where he served two [years] and four remain, let him return to him four [years' worth] from 'the money that he was bought for,' whether he depreciated or appreciated; and where he served four [years] and two remain for him, let him return to him two [years' worth] 'according to his years,' whether he depreciated or appreciated." And it is for this [purpose] that the superfluous wording of the verse comes: [to teach] that we always follow the closer [point in time]:

Tosafot on Arakhin 30b:2:1.hebrew: דתניא כי טוב לו עמך - הכי איתא בכל הספרים, ונראה דלא גרסינן הכי, דאין זה כי אם סיפור דברים של העבד: "כי אהבך ואת ביתך כי טוב לו עמך", ואין זה ציווי; אלא גרס כדאיתא בסיפרי: "כתושב כשכיר יהיה עמך", דהיינו ציווי:
Tosafot on Arakhin 30b:2:1.english: As it is taught: Because he fares well with you - So it is in all the books, [but] it seems that we do not read it thus, for this is nothing other than a narration of the slave's words: "because he loves you and your household, because he fares well with you" [Deuteronomy 15:16], and this is not a commandment. Rather, read as it appears in the Sifrei: "as a resident, as a hired laborer he shall be with you" [Leviticus 25:40], which is a commandment:

Tosafot on Arakhin 30b:3:1.hebrew: כמה קשה אבקה של שביעית - פירוש, דהיינו סחורה, דאין זה עיקר האיסור, דעיקר האיסור הוא חרישה וזריעה. ואם תאמר: ומנלן דעל ידי סחורה בלבד קלקולים אלו שמפרש כאן באין עליו, דלמא על ידי חרישה וזריעה דוקא הם באים? וי"ל דהיינו מדה כנגד מדה: ע"י שמכר פירות שביעית, הוא מוכר את אשר לו:
Tosafot on Arakhin 30b:3:1.english: How severe is the dust [i.e., secondary prohibition] of the Sabbatical Year - Meaning: this refers to commerce [in Sabbatical-year produce], for this is not the primary prohibition, as the primary prohibition is plowing and sowing. And if you ask: From where do we know that these calamities that [the Gemara] explains here come upon him through commerce alone — perhaps they come specifically through plowing and sowing? One can answer that this is measure for measure: because he sold Sabbatical-year produce, he [comes to] sell that which is his:
